title: Shamley Green Circular Walk Route

images.title: Colin Smith / Shamley Green
images.caption: Shamley Green. Shamley Green is a charming and picturesque village nestled in the heart of the Surrey Hills, an Area of Outstanding Natural Beauty, approximately five miles south of Guildford. Characterised by its traditional cottages and mix of homes, the village retains a strong sense of community, centered around its two public greens. These greens are not just scenic focal points; one has hosted cricket for over 160 years and remains the venue for the annual village fete and occasional summer fairs, fostering a vibrant local life.

images.title: Colin Smith / Wey and Arun Canal
images.caption: Wey and Arun Canal near Shamley Green. Historically, local archaeological finds suggest a Romano-British presence, and the village itself was first recorded as "Shamele" in 1332. Over centuries, it evolved from an isolated agricultural hamlet to the community it is today, with many of its old timber-framed buildings still standing as listed properties, some traceable back to the 13th, 14th, and 15th centuries. This deep-rooted history, combined with its natural beauty and active community, makes Shamley Green a highly desirable location for those seeking a peaceful rural escape with convenient access to larger towns like Guildford and Cranleigh.

description: This circular walk explores the countryside around the Surrey village of Shamley Green. The walk runs for just under 6 miles, following a series of public footpaths through the surrounding countryside of the Surrey Hills AONB. The route includes a section along the Wey and Arun Canal Walk, a waymarked trail running to the west of the village. Here you can enjoy an easy waterside walk along the peaceful canal before returning to Shamley Green.

details.subtitle: Pubs/Cafes
details.content: Despite its tranquil, rural setting, Shamley Green is well-equipped with essential amenities. It boasts two popular pubs, The Red Lion and The Bricklayers Arms, alongside a village shop with a post office, a health and beauty shop, and a cook shop. The village also caters to families with a pre-school and two primary schools. Beyond the practicalities, Shamley Green is home to a number of thriving social organisations, including a Village Association, a History Society, and a Gardening Club, with many activities centered at the Arbuthnot Hall by the cricket green.
